title: 第3章 刀法入门第4章 杀人
content_zh:
苏牧一直觉得，每一滴汗水都不会白流。
他苦练刀法一整日，终于有了收获。
“我果然没有猜错，面板上的点数，可以给武学加点。
以前我坐拥宝山却无法利用，如今蛟龙入海，海阔天空。”
苏牧心中充满了莫大的欢喜，长久以来的苦日子，终于是熬到头了。
有面板在，哪怕无人指点，哪怕他不知道伏波刀法的运力法门，只要有点数，他就可以直接提升伏波刀法的境界。
只要闭门苦修，他就能慢慢地将这门武学熬练至成。
苏牧深吸一口气，表情严肃，目光郑重地看着面板，然后意念一动，向着那个“+”
点了下去。
轰！
一抹金光闪过，苏牧只感觉有什么东西粗暴地插入他的脑海之中，然后轰然炸裂开来。
海量的信息在他脑海中肆虐着。
原本只是照猫画虎习成的伏波刀法招式，在这些信息当中一招一式地被纠正过来。
每一招该如何使劲、如何发力，招式的正确用法是什么，全都深深的烙印在他脑海之中。
就仿佛他经过名师指点，按照绝对正确的练习路线，苦练了数月时间。
当脑海中翻天覆地的变化彻底平静下来之后。
苏牧深深吸了一口气，握住了他的柴刀。
顿时，一种截然不同的感觉油然而生，虽然握着的还是那把锈迹斑斑的破旧柴刀，但苏牧感觉自己真正地变成了一个刀客。
伏波刀法的十三式，每一式以及所有的变化，此刻全都烂熟于心。
如何运刀，如何发力，如何变化，如何对敌，所有的东西都变得清清楚楚，不像之前，就只会比划一些动作。

“刀法真的入门了，就这么轻轻一点，我就好像真的练刀几个月一般，连身上的伤势都痊愈了，身体也比之前强壮了一些。”
感受着身体的变化，苏牧也注意到了面板的变化。
【姓名：苏牧】
【身份：砍柴人（流民）】
【点数：5】
【武艺：伏波刀法（入门）】
伏波刀法入门之后，后面的“+”
已经消失不见，而点数，也减少了10点。
按照秘籍记载，伏波刀法分为入门、小成、大成、圆满四重境界。
若是习练得法，一般人三到六个月可以入门，一两年可以小成，这个时候持刀胜过两三个不会武艺的持械匪徒已经没有问题了。
五六年可练至大成，寻常五六个敌手也能应付。
content_en:
Su Mu always felt that every drop of sweat would not be in vain.
He practiced sword skills hard all day and finally got something.
"Sure enough, I guessed right. The points on the panel can be used to add points to martial arts.
In the past, I was sitting on a treasure mountain but could not use it. Now the dragon has entered the sea and the sea and sky are vast. "
Su Mu's heart was filled with great joy. The long hard days were finally over.
With the panel, even if there is no one to give guidance, even if he does not know the Fubo Sword Technique, as long as he has some points, he can directly improve the realm of Fubo Sword Technique.
As long as he practices hard behind closed doors, he can slowly master this martial arts to perfection.
Su Mu took a deep breath, looked seriously at the panel, and then moved his mind towards the "+"
Clicked.
boom!
A flash of golden light flashed, and Su Mu felt something roughly inserted into his mind, and then exploded with a bang.
A huge amount of information was raging in his mind.
The Fubo Sword Techniques, which were originally just learned from cats and tigers, were corrected one by one in this information.
How to use each move, how to exert force, and what is the correct use of the moves are all deeply imprinted in his mind.
It was as if he had been taught by a famous teacher and followed the absolutely correct training route and practiced hard for several months.
After the earth-shaking changes in my mind completely calmed down.
Su Mu took a deep breath and held his hatchet.
Suddenly, a completely different feeling emerged. Although he was still holding the rusty and old hatchet, Su Mu felt that he had truly become a swordsman.
The thirteen moves of the Fubo Sword Technique, each move and all its changes, are all familiar by heart at this moment.
How to wield the knife, how to exert force, how to change, how to face the enemy, everything has become clear, unlike before, where I could only make some gestures.
"I really got started with swordsmanship. With just one tap, I felt like I had really practiced swordsmanship for several months. Even the injuries on my body have healed and my body is stronger than before."
Feeling the changes in his body, Su Mu also noticed the changes in the panel.
[Name: Su Mu]
[Identity: woodcutter (refugee)]
[Points: 5]
[Martial Arts: Fubo Sword Technique (Introduction)]
After getting started with Fubo Sword Technique, the “+” at the end
It has disappeared, and the points have also been reduced by 10 points.
According to the secret book, Fubo Sword Technique is divided into four levels: Beginner, Small Success, Dacheng and Perfection.
If practiced well, the average person can get started in three to six months, and can achieve success in one or two years. At this time, it is no problem to be able to defeat two or three armed gangsters who do not know martial arts with a knife.
It takes five or six years to practice to achieve great success, and you can usually deal with five or six opponents.
